Reproduced after: 403 refusal_kind=anonymous, nothing executed; a signed-in caller attesting someone else's name gets 403 refusal_kind=impersonation with BOTH principals hash-chained (verified live at seq 1605); a matching attestation succeeds and records approver_source=session. The identity-minting POLICY is attached to the capability, not to one flag: AUTH_DISABLED, MOCK_LOGIN and the default session secret each refuse a protected-env boot by name, and /auth/mock 404s outside dev/test.
